comment: zstd-jni's C code writes the stream position and frame-state fields back into the Java
objects through JNI, so they must be JNI-accessible in the native image. The native methods
themselves need no entry: GraalVM resolves their symbols from the loaded library.
Registered as whole-class field sets because the exact set the C code touches is an upstream
implementation detail that can change within a patch release; the pinned directory name is
what ties this file to a version.
